annotations.title: Sync a user's wishlist into the cache

description: Mirror a user's Untappd wishlist (user/wishlist) into the local cache, so pick tools can boost wishlisted beers without an API call. Each sync is a full pass from the top (~25 beers per call; wishlists are small), adding new beers and — once the pass finishes — dropping ones no longer wishlisted (a partial pass never deletes). Resumable: saves progress every page; run again until another_run_needed is false. Stops BEFORE the ~100 calls/hour rate limit (or cleanly on a 429) with stopped_for_rate_limit and rate_limit.resume_at. Only reads Untappd — never changes the wishlist (that is untappd_wishlist_add / _remove). Omit username for your own account; another user's wishlist needs a public account or friendship.

max_pages.description: Pages (~25 beers each) to fetch this run (default 10, max 50).

username.description: Untappd username. Omit to use your own configured account (UNTAPPD_USERNAME).
